title: chart-validate
intention: Stage 7 of the /chart chain — the VALIDATE brick, and the stone plan's LAST stage: what does DONE mean for this request, measured? Not what the pieces are, their order, or what each will do — what the WHOLE must demonstrate at acceptance. Every CRITERION carries its claim, its named instrument, and covers — the pieces it closes; the union of covers equals the hypothesize berth's claimed pieces (every piece's done is measured). Three strata: FLOOR — template-filled from the berthed hypothesize packet (the chain deepens to depth 7: validate -> hypothesize -> triage -> decompose -> survey -> constrain -> orient, re-checked whole by composing hypothesize's own chain reader BY IDENTITY — each stage owns exactly one new link), handing the ceiling the intent, the bounds, the hypotheses verbatim (whose instruments criteria may compose), the order, and the judges' vocabulary (claimed_pieces — the exact set covers must exhaust); TREE — the validate brick's own corpus; CEILING — the acceptance judgment, per-field provenance. Built UNDER the pre-installed judges (ticket validate-filters). With this stone the preamble is WHOLE: orient/constrain/survey/decompose/triage/hypothesize/validate — the full chain Akien named, each stage a proven brick.
why: The 2026-07-24 correction, made structure at the chain's end: done is verified in the world by the instrument, never the narration. The success_criteria growth was an IOU from the day the wire landed (packet-inspector-wire edge (a)); it comes due here because validate is its natural home — decompose emits pieces, triage order, hypothesize mechanism claims; only the acceptance stage can say what the WHOLE must show. The criteria also hand /sail its future: a berthed criteria set is an executable acceptance run waiting for the step that fires it at PROVED.
traces_to: Law 3 — done is a measured claim; the criteria are its instruments, named before the build ends
Law 1 — what done means is compiled once, at the chain's end, instead of re-argued at every boundary
Law 4 — the judges + schema make an unmeasured or partial done a build error, not a lapse
Law 8 — the brick's first berthed packet passes judges it did not write (validate-filters, the live gate)

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: test_chart_validate.py (chain physics at depth 7 — refuses without a readable hypothesize berth, and a broken link anywhere below refuses loudly; floor hands the acceptance vocabulary verbatim from the berth; schema gate refuses hollow shapes; door composes judge_validate BY IDENTITY; berth round-trips; deposit-back gated; import allowlist over import_map) under the tester's netns seal. Live gate: a real validate packet for THIS ticket berths through judges the module did not write, deposits back, and registers on the dial.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: stage 7 filling from the conversation instead of the berthed stage-6 file; the floor re-walking the chain in parallel instead of composing hypothesize's reader; a criterion without its instrument, a covers entry on an unclaimed piece, or a piece no criterion covers passing the door; the door and the promotion gate disagreeing; the dial unable to read a validate berth; the deposit-back seeding the tree with a packet whose berth is not on disk.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when /sail grows the step that RUNS a berthed criteria set at PROVED (the natural next compilation — acceptance as an executed gate, not a read record); when the first real acceptance run shows whether instrument wants structure; when Akien returns and names what follows the completed preamble.
